pages.text: The $(item)Celestial Enchanting Table$() grants enchantments beyond the reach of vanilla enchanting - including $(l)exclusive enchantments$() found nowhere else.$(br2)$(l)Structure:$()$(br)Build a pillar at each of the 4 corners: 2 stacked $(item)Lunar Pillars$() crowned with a $(item)Celestial Tile$().

pages.title: Focus Patterns
pages.text: Arrange $(item)Moonlight Focus$() blocks around the table in specific $(l)patterns$() and link each one to the table with the $(item)Linking Wand$().$(br2)The detected pattern determines $(l)which enchantments$() can be applied. Foci also transfer the $(mana)mana$() needed for enchanting.

pages.title: How to Use
pages.text: $(li)Right-click with an item to place it on the table$(li)$(l)Shift + Right-click$() to start enchanting$(li)Right-click empty-handed to view status (readiness, pattern, mana)$(br2)If the item, pattern, and mana all match a recipe, the celestial enchantment is applied after a short channeling time.
